product_one_liner.value: Incorta is a governed data and analytics platform for enterprise teams that connects live, detailed data from systems of record to analytics, AI agents, applications, and workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The Incorta site’s navigation/footer has no pricing link; the /pricing URL returned only a 301 response, not a pricing page. Marketplace pricing listings are not a pricing page on Incorta’s site.

named_customers.notes: All three are listed as customer stories on Incorta’s customers page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Incorta in the 201–500 employee size band.

hq_location.notes: Incorta’s contact page identifies its Main Headquarters in Foster City, California; LinkedIn identifies the company’s country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Incorta’s company profile gives 2013, and its history starts with founders creating platform prototypes in 2013; a 2021 press release refers to 2014, so the reported year is somewhat inconsistent.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering@Incorta publication identifies itself as technical writing from Incorta engineers and includes multiple technical posts, including work on agent architecture and the platform’s data/joins approach.

public_docs.notes: Incorta provides a public documentation portal with guides, references, release documentation, and multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Lever posting is titled Senior AI/ML Engineer and includes an Apply link.

model_provider.value: OpenAI and Azure OpenAI are configurable model providers; the documentation lists OpenAI models such as GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo.
model_provider.notes: Incorta documents selectable primary and secondary model providers, rather than one mandatory provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 Type II and GDPR; CCPA is not among the requested options.

last_funding.notes: Incorta announced this $120 million Series D on June 23, 2021. PitchBook now shows a conflicting April 24, 2025 financing date for a $120 million Series D; no corresponding company announcement was found, so the dated company announcement is used as the confirmed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The publicly announced last round was June 2021, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; the April 2025 date shown by PitchBook is also before that window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Lever job board lists an Account Executive, and a Sales Development Representative posting also has an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 12, 2026 release notes announced Incorta AI Applications as generally available, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company’s small leadership roster was checked; the dated CTO appointment announcement is October 7, 2025, before the 12-month window beginning November 9, 2025. No C-level or VP appointment/departure in the requested window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named in Incorta sales and marketing job descriptions; Salesforce and Outreach are specified for prospect interaction tracking, while HubSpot and Marketo are listed as CRM/marketing automation integration examples.
